summary: LOCAL DB only (IST today 2026-10-24). Tested the 3 Paid Leave enhancements. (1) Monthly generation now uses only Active + confirmed Full-time employees: status eligible_count equals the balances-table length (5 seeded), and the generate count/message match it. In the 2030-02 generation, inactive stayed at 1, intern and unconfirmed stayed at 0, negative went from -1 to 0 and fulltime2 from 2 to 3. A second generate for the same month returned 400 'already generated'; the generation was then reverted and its record deleted. (2) Rejecting an approved paid leave returns the balance exactly once: full day +1, First Half and Second Half +0.5 each, admin-created 2-day leave +2. Repeated rejects add nothing. Re-approving deducts again and leaves the status finalized. Re-approving with 0.5 balance against a 1-day leave returns 400 and the leave stays rejected/released. Repeated approve/reject cycles never inflate the balance. Rejecting a pending paid leave also returns the balance once; rejecting a normal leave changes nothing. An approved advance leave (Nov 2026) for fulltime0 went -1 -> 0 on reject with advance_settlement 'reversed'. All 3 balance endpoints showed the same value. (3) Export Excel (API): header row is exactly Employee Name/Team/Available Paid Leave; only Active confirmed FT rows; balance cells are numbers (-1, 0.5, 0 kept); search=TEST_PL_full returns only fulltime0 and fulltime2; employee token gets 403, no token 401/403. UI (Playwright): all buttons are present (Generate/Export/CSV/Import/History plus the new Export Excel next to search). Export Excel downloaded Employee_Paid_Leave_Balances_2026-10-24.xlsx with correct contents, the search was applied to the download, and the 'Export downloaded' toast appeared. New suite: 12/12 passed. Regression: test_advance_paid_leave.py + test_consider_as_paid_leave.py 30/30 passed. All test data was cleaned up (TEST_PL_ employees/users/leaves/history, notifications, generation records); verified 0 left.
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing test hygiene risk: tests/test_consider_as_paid_leave.py::test_generate_future_month_then_approve_paid generates 2030-01 for ALL eligible employees but its teardown only deletes the generation record. It does not reverse the +1 for non-TEST employees. This is harmless on the current local DB (0 real employees) but would inflate real balances on a populated DB. Consider reverting via paid_leave_history like test_paid_leave_iter96._revert_generation.
Approve/reject still send emails whenever official_email is set (seed uses example.invalid, so nothing is delivered). Expected existing behaviour.
server.py is >21k lines; paid-leave logic would benefit from extraction into its own module.
